item.description:
New

  • Archive stale attention inbox rows in one step with a cleanup card at the top of the list; the menu bar badge now always matches the needs-attention count in the window.
  • Approval push notifications sent to your paired iPhone are now sealed on your Mac, so command details stay encrypted until they reach your phone.

Improved

  • Reach attention inbox rows with the keyboard and open them with Return.
  • Rewrite English interface copy across the app for clearer, more consistent wording.
  • Replace the promo video on the product site with footage of the real app.

Note

  • Requires macOS 14.0 or later.
